choice: Split on ';', take the first part that is a 16-point compass name (N, NE, NNW...) or contains a number (first number, so '45-135' gives 45), normalize to 0-360 (so '-90' gives 270); fall back to camera:direction; else null
text: How is the OSM direction tag parsed into Camera.direction?
why: Matches the interface doc and the forms these tags take in OSM; direction is only shown, never used for routing (hub.16)
